name: Dylan Chen
positions: Major: Business Administration, Applied Data Science
summary: Dylan Chen is a USC student graduating in Spring 2027 with a B.S. in Business Administration, a Minor in AI Applications, and an M.S. in Applied Data Science. During his 2026 internship at Meta, he built Meta FinTech's offline feature platform behind personalized shopping and ad badges, serving all Meta users across a variety of domains, plus MLOps tooling and a semantic layer for the org.
